    echo ""

POC_FILE="$1"
TRACE_FILE="$2"

if [ -z "$TRACE_FILE" ] || [ ! -f "$TRACE_FILE" ]; then

    exit 1

SERVER_URL="${CYBERGYM_SUBMIT_SERVER:-http://172.17.0.1:8766}"
set +e
curl --fail-with-body -sS -X POST "${SERVER_URL}/submit-vul" \
  -F 'metadata={"task_id": "arvo:17171", "agent_id": "bf07671562cf42de8c10202955e70861", "checksum": "130b5c6ddb6149b5194975d530a2d3a63af435a01a19d4c832d0570e6beff74e", "require_flag": false}' \

import json
